thought.text: Dev server is stopped and port 3000 is free. Let me verify asset references and start the production static server.

reasoning_content: The dev server got terminated (pkill matched my own shell's `next dev` string, which is why it was killed with exit 143). Port 3000 is currently free. Let me verify that the static assets exist and start the production serve.

action.command: cd /workspace && ASSET=$(grep -o '/_next/static/[^"]*\.js' build/index.html | head -1) && echo "asset ref: $ASSET" && test -f "build$ASSET" && echo "asset exists in build" || echo "asset MISSING"; CSS=$(grep -o '/_next/static/[^"]*\.css' build/index.html | head -1) && test -f "build$CSS" && echo "css $CSS exists" || echo "css MISSING"; JS=$(find build/_next -name '*.js' | wc -l); CSSN=$(find build/_next -name '*.css' | wc -l); echo "build js files: $JS, css files: $CSSN"
